requirements.description: Replace the skip_if_no_matplotlib helper with class-level decorators on BasePlottingTests (td.skip_if_no("matplotlib") plus the pyparsing filterwarnings mark).

label.evidence: pandas/tests/extension/base/plotting.py:123 (after code): class BasePlottingTests: has no decorators; the helper method and the warnings/Version imports are removed; tests use mpl_cleanup_context()
label.notes: Reviewer asked to replace skip_if_no_matplotlib with class-level td.skip_if_no and filterwarnings decorators. The author reported that this fails in the minimum-versions environment and the reviewer accepted ("Gotcha, thanks for checking"). The final code has no class decorators; the helper is removed and tests use mpl_cleanup_context instead. Where the matplotlib skip and pyparsing warning filter now live is not visible in the diff.

adjudication_reason:
: Although the author did not implement the suggested class-level decorators, they tested the approach and demonstrated that it fails in the minimum-versions environment because pyparsing deprecation warnings occur during decorator evaluation, before the warning filter can take effect. The reviewer explicitly acknowledged this explanation with “Gotcha, thanks for checking,” indicating acceptance of the technical limitation.
Therefore, the review concern was resolved through discussion and validation, rather than by implementing the proposed code change. Labeling it NOT_SATISFIED would overlook the reviewer's acceptance.
